extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A synthetic texture dataset of 246,285 images across 56 texture classes, generated using text-to-image (Stable Diffusion) models with texture-specific prompts and a three-stage refinement process consisting of frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP scoring.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak, Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by generating texture images using Stable Diffusion text-to-image models, guided by structured descriptive prompts. Prompts were constructed by combining descriptors across categories (artistic, spatial, color enhancer, color, texture) to produce 96,768 unique prompts. Five images were generated per prompt, followed by a three-stage refinement process (frequency filtering, patch variance filtering, and CLIP score filtering) to yield 246,285 final images.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Images flagged as NSFW by the Stable Diffusion safety filter were excluded from the dataset and regenerated to ensure a consistent number of images per prompt. Flagged images were not released publicly.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consists of images generated by the Stable Diffusion model using 96,768 unique text prompts describing textures across 56 texture classes, producing 483,840 images before refinement.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: CLIP filtering used as part of multi-step filtering process for dataset refinement
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset shows variation across texture classes, with certain textures performing better than others. Textures that appear in common objects (e.g., hairy, flaky) tend to have better scores, while more structured textures (e.g., grid, polka-dotted) tend to have worse scores, indicating potential bias in generation quality across texture types.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is generated using Stable Diffusion and may be limited in representing structured textures. The standard metrics (Inception and FID) were originally designed for object-based datasets, limiting their direct applicability to texture evaluation. Additionally, safety filter sensitivity in text-to-image pipelines posed unique challenges during generation.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables research into texture bias in AI models, which has implications for understanding and mitigating biases in object classification and other vision tasks. It also supports the study of adversarial examples based on textures.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for use in texture-based research tasks including training and evaluating models for texture classification, measuring texture bias in object classification models (via Texture Object Association Values), constructing texture-object associations, and studying adversarial examples. It supports large-scale texture analysis and model generalization evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is available for download on Zenodo.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Multi-step filtering refinement process including frequency-based filtering, patch variance filtering, and CLIP filtering to remove non-representative images while preserving textural complexity.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images generated using Stable Diffusion model from HuggingFace; dataset evaluated pre- and post-refinement using Inception and FID scores; multi-step filtering process applied to enhance quality and representativeness.
